Commentary.Commentary: Right then, the first game is done and it is Australia Women who have come out on top once again and have remained unbeaten. In the next game of the day, India Women take on Barbados Women. The winner of that game will be the second team to progress to the semi-final from Group A. The action for that match is set to begin at 10.30 pm IST (5.00 pm GMT). Our build-up though will begin much sooner. See you then. Cheers!

Earlier, Australia Women won the toss and elected to bat first. They struggled to get going and as a result, put 22 runs on the board and lost two wickets. They scored their lowest total in the Powerplay over the last 18 games. This was probably the only time, that Pakistan Women were in the game. However, Beth Mooney and Tahlia McGrath had other ideas, as they steadied the ship and then began an onslaught towards the end. They achieved the record third-wicket partnership for Australia Women in the process and took the game completely away from Pakistan Women.

The Australian juggernaut continues to bulldoze its way into the knockout stages. After securing their place for the semi-finals in the last game, they have now put themselves in pole position in the group. Another complete performance by the whole team, with the bowlers being accurate and never letting their opponents with a whiff of an opportunity. They bowled tight lines and Tahlia McGrath was the pick of the bowlers claiming three wickets for 13 runs in the three overs that she bowled. The bowlers had an easy task as the games had already been set up by the batters.

Pakistan Women had their task cut out and things just got worse as they lost Muneeba Ali with no runs on the board. The skipper Bismah Maroof, never really got going as she kept accumulating runs with no real intent. Omaima Sohail and Fatima Sana played a cameo but at no point did it seem that they could set up a run chase. Fatima Sana was probably the only one who took the attack to the champions and ended her innings unbeaten on 35. This has been a consistent issue for this team as they have been unable to score freely at the international level. Their journey in the Commonwealth Games comes to end and they will have to rework their plans for the future.

Just as we expected the target was way out of reach for Pakistan Women. They have fallen short by 44 runs and Australia Women clinch the top spot in Group A. Pakistan Women will exit the tournament with no wins under their belt. This has been another commanding performance by the ladies from Down Under!
Fuller one, around middle. Aiman Anwer gets low and reverse-sweeps this one towards short third man for a single. Australia Women win by 44 runs and continue their unbeaten streak!
Wide! Down the leg side again. Aiman Anwer misses her flick. Wide called!
Another yorker, outside off. Fatima Sana squeezes it out towards cover for a single.
SIX! KABOOM! Slightly shorter, outside off. Fatima Sana steps down the track and slashes it over cover-point for a biggie!
A yorker now, around middle. Fatima Sana does well to dig this one out.
Wide! Down the leg side. Fatima Sana leaves it alone. Wide given!
Goes 'round the wicket now, a length ball, around middle and leg. Aiman Anwer flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Fatima Sana drives it towards cover for a single.

OUT! LBW! Jess Jonassen gets a wicket on the final delivery of the over! Diana Baig is on her way back. Change of angle for Jess Jonassen. She goes over the wicket, serves a shorter one, around the leg pole. Diana Baig misses her flick and gets hit on her pads. The finger goes up after the appeal. No review taken! The replay shows that it was pitching outside leg!
THREE WIDES! Another shorter one, down leg once again. Diana Baig misses her flick. Alyssa Healy fails to grab the ball as well. They take two more runs!
Wide! Spills this one down the leg side. Wide called!
Fuller again, around middle. Fatima Sana drives it towards long on for another run.
SIX! BANG! Another loopy one, full, around off. Fatima Sana gets under this one and tonks it high over long on for a biggie!
Pitches it up again, fuller ball, around middle. Diana Baig sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Diana Baig leans forward and tucks it towards square leg.
A slightly shorter one, around middle. Fatima Sana flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Jess Jonassen comes to bowl the penultimate over!
Full and sliding down the leg, Fatima Sana helps it of her pads through mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! This is on a good length and around off, Fatima Sana goes for the square cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes short this time and outside off, Fatima Sana stays back and punches it towards deep point for a brace.
Pulls her length back a bit and on off, Diana Baig gets a leading edge towards backward point. They cross.
WIDE! Fuller one but way down the leg side. Wided.
On a length and on off, Fatima Sana pushes it gently towards point and gets across for a single. A direct hit and it would have been close.
FOUR! A little too late but they will take it. This is short and outside off, Fatima Sana stands tall and punches it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Full again and on the leg stump, Diana Baig moves across and tucks it mid-wicket. A double-wicket over comes to an end.
Goes full and on middle, Diana Baig knocks it towards mid on with the inner half of her willow.
No hat-trick for Tahlia McGrath. This is on a good length and outside off, Diana Baig leaves it alone.
Diana Baig walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! LBW! Two wickets in two balls for Tahlia McGrath and her third overall! What a day Tahlia McGrath is having! A length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Tuba Hassan plays this across the line and she tries to flick this one. But she misses and gets rapped on her pads. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises her finger! Tuba Hassan walks back to the hut. Tahlia McGrath is on a hat-trick!
Tuba Hassan walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tahlia McGrath is everywhere on the field and she picks up her second wicket. This is on a length and on middle, Bismah Maroof tries to play it to the leg side but closes the face of her bat early and only manages to lob the ball towards mid on. Jess Jonassen there takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jess Jonassen b Tahlia McGrath

Commentary.Commentary: This is quciker and shorter on middle and leg, Bismah Maroof tries to pull it but misses and gets hit on her shoulder. The deflects towards the keeper but she cannot grab it cleanly.
Ashleigh Gardner goes full once again and angled into the pads, Fatima Sana clips this watchfully towards mid-wicket. Just 2 runs of the over!
Ashleigh Gardner goes back to bowling short outside off, Fatima Sana looks to cut and gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is full and angling into the stumps, Fatima Sana works this towards mid-wicket.
Short once again and wide outside off, Bismah Maroof guides this towards third man for a single.
This is short and wide outside off, Bismah Maroof looks to cut and mistimes it towards point.
Ashleigh Gardner starts with a full delivery outside off, Fatima Sana charges down the wicket and lofts the ball towards long on for a single.
Shorter one, outside off. Fatima Sana cuts it towards point for a single.

FOUR BYES! A fuller one, this one skids through the surface, towards the leg pole. Fatima Sana plays all over it it and misses it. Alyssa Healy fails to grab this one as well. It runs behind towards third man for a boundary.
Slower through the air, a low full toss, around middle. Bismah Maroof heaves it towards mid-wicket for a single.

A stifled appeal there for LBW only from the bowler. The umpire is not interested in that! Quicker, shorter, around off. Fatima Sana cuts this one late towards point for a single. Alana King probably thought that hit the pad before the bat.
Tosses this one up, outside off, fuller ball. Fatima Sana drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, fuller one, around middle. Bismah Maroof slog-sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
This is short and wide outside off, Fatima Sana looks to cut this and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Well outside off and on a fuller length. Bismah Maroof works this towards cover for a single.
Full once again and angled into the pads, Fatima Sana clips this towards square leg for a single.
Banged in short and angling down leg. Fatima Sana leaves this alone and is called wide by the umpire.
This is full and on middle and leg, Fatima Sana fends this back down the pitch.
This is a fraction short and in line with the body, Fatima Sana flicks this off her hips to square leg for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Edged for a boundary! Darcie Brown goes full and outside off, Fatima Sana looks to play this through the offside and gets a thick edge that flies to the vacant third man fence for four more runs! Need many more of these!
This is wide outside off and on a fuller length. Fatima Sana guides this to third man for a single to keep strike.
Fraction short and outside off, Bismah Maroof guides this to backward point for a single.
Fatima Sana makes her way out in the middle.

OUT! Tahlia McGrath can do nothing wrong today! Gets a wicket under her belt as well! She serves this full and outside off, Ayesha Naseem looks to heave this one over deep mid-wicket but manages to top edge it towards the fielder there. Alana King does well to run back and take a wonderful catch! Ayesha Naseem has to depart and Australia Women are right on top here!
Commentary.Howout: c Alana King b Tahlia McGrath

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This goes past the diving mid off fielder! Tahlia McGrath goes full and outside off, Ayesha Naseem hits this uppishly towards mid off. Does not time this well at all but is straight enough to go past the fielder to long off for a boundary!
This is on a good length and outside off, Ayesha Naseem looks to work this offside and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tahlia McGrath goes full and angles the ball into the pads, Bismah Maroof clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
A full toss to end the ever as this is lofted on a bounce towards long on for another run. 106 runs needed in 48 balls.
Bowls this a bit short and on off, Ayesha Naseem makes room and slaps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, Ayesha Naseem leans on and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up around middle, Bismah Maroof uses her feet and chips it over the bowler's head towards long off for a run.
Flatter and quicker on off, Bismah Maroof tries to go for the reverse sweep but misses.
Short and outside off, Ayesha Naseem stays back and forces it wide of long off for a single.
Much fuller now, around off. Ayesha Naseem drags this one from the inner half of her bat towards mid on. A single to end the over!
Darcie Brown drops it short this time, around middle. Ayesha Naseem ducks underneath it.
Back of a length, outside off. Ayesha Naseem gets on top of the bounce and pushes it towards cover.
Beaten! A length delivery this time, outside off, shaping away a tad, at 111.7 clicks. Ayesha Naseem looks to have a poke at it but she misses.
Tight single! Tad fuller again, outside off. Bismah Maroof pushes it towards mid off and takes a quick single. 50 up for Australia Women!
On a length, a touch slower, around off. Bismah Maroof blocks it out.
Short and outside off, Ayesha Naseem punches it to covers of her back foot.
On middle and leg, blocked towards mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Ayesha Naseem knocks it to covers. Bismah Maroof this tiem denies for the run loud and clear.
Full againg and around middle, this is slapped towards mid off for one.
Floated around middle, Ayesha Naseem eases it to long off for a single and gets off the mark.
Ayesha Naseem makes her way out to the middle.

OUT! RUN OUT! A mix-up in the middle and Aliya Riaz has to go back. This is tossed up full down the leg, Bismah Maroof sweeps it towards fine leg for one. Aliya Riaz wants the second and her partner responds to it. Bismah Maroof though turns blindly and refuses the run halfway through. Tahlia McGrath picks up the ball and throws it towards the keeper Alyssa Healy, who does the rest. Aliya Riaz is nowhere near her crease and she has to take the long walk back. Another one down for Pakistan.
Flighted on middle, Aliya Riaz tries to go for the sweep but misses and gets hit on her helmet off the bat.
Slower through the air on off, turning in a bit, Aliya Riaz goes for the block but gets beaten all ends up.
Tossed up full and on off, Bismah Maroof works it towards covers for a run.
Floated around off, Aliya Riaz drives it through covers and gets off the mark with a single.
Short and outside off, Aliya Riaz guides it to point.
Aliya Riaz comes to the crease.

OUT! BOWLED! Alana King comes into the attack and gets a wicket straightway. This is pushed through a bit quicker on middle, and skids through the surface. Omaima Sohail tries to flick it but plays down the wrong line. The ball goes through her defense and crashes into the stumps. Omaima Sohail was looking good but she has to depart and Australia Women have got the third wicket!

DROPPED! Australia Women do not give their opponents a chance. This one though has been put down! Ashleigh Gardner flights this full outside off, Bismah Maroof shuffles down the wicket and hits this straight to mid off. Grace Harris has missed a sitter as she takes her eyes off the ball. Bismah Maroof gets a life!
Beaten! Ashleigh Gardner goes a fraction short and outside off, Bismah Maroof looks to cut and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Ashleigh Gardner goes full and outside off, Omaima Sohail plays this uppishly towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Omaima Sohail gets another one away! This is full and on off, Omaima Sohail gets on her knees and sweeps this well to beat the fine leg fielder to her left for four more runs!
This is full and in line with the stumps, Bismah Maroof paddles this in the air towards fine leg for a single.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Bismah Maroof punches the ball towards backward point.
Ashleigh Gardner is brought into the attack.
Tahlia McGrath goes full outside off, Bismah Maroof works this towards deep cover for a single.
FOUR! This is a good shot! A length ball. outside off. Bismah Maroof backs away and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Goes full once again and angles this into the stumps, Bismah Maroof fends this back towards the bowler.
Goes 'round the wicket and serves this on a length outside off, Bismah Maroof fends this towards cover.
Wide outside off and on a fuller length. Omaima Sohail guides the ball towards deep point for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, Omaima Sohail looks to drive and is beaten on the outside edge.
Tahlia McGrath is introduced into the attack!
Tosses this one up, full and around off. Omaima Sohail sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single. Pakistan Women are 32 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Goes full and outside off, Omaima Sohail fends this towards the cover fielder.
Full and outside off, Omaima Sohail goes for the reverse sweep and gets glove on this as it goes fine towards third man for a couple of runs.
Jess Jonassen goes over the wicket and serves this full and angling into the stumps, Bismah Maroof clips this to square leg for a single.
Jess Jonassen goes full and in line with the stumps, Omaima Sohail flicks this to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! This is been wacked! Jess Jonassen flights this full outside off, Omaima Sohail gets down the wicket and lofts it over mid on for a boundary! Omaima Sohail wants to take the attack on!
Jess Jonassen comes back in the attack. She went for 4 runs in her first over!
This is short as well and in line with the stumps, Omaima Sohail pulls this to deep backward square leg for a single.
This is full and wide outside off, Omaima Sohail leaves this alone and looks for a wide. Close call and the umpire's arms stay down
This is a fraction short and outside off, Omaima Sohail guides this towards short third man.
Full and outside off, Omaima Sohail knocks this towards cover.

FOUR! Omaima Sohail gets a hold of this one! Megan Schutt ges full once again and outside off, Omaima Sohail gets across the stumps and sweeps this towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary!
Megan Schutt begins with a full delivery outside off, Omaima Sohail knocks this towards covers.
Megan Schutt comes back into the attack.
Back of a length, outside off. Bismah Maroof dabs it towards cover. She wanted a single there, but she is sent back!
A good-length delivery, around middle. Bismah Maroof drags it with the inner half of her bat through mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Bismah Maroof taps it towards the fielder at point.
Wide! Full and angling away wide of off. Bismah Maroof leaves it alone. Wided!
On a length, outside off. Bismah Maroof dabs it towards backward point. No run there!
Pitches it up this time, around off. Omaima Sohail drives it wide of mid off and rotates the strike!
Slightly shorter, around middle and off. Omaima Sohail stays in her crease and blocks it out solidly.
Wide! Darcie Brown errs in line again, as she serves this down the leg side. Omaima Sohail goes for the flick but she misses. Wide called!
Wide! A length ball, down the leg side. Omaima Sohail misses her flick. Wide called!
Outside off, tosses it up, slower as well. Omaima Sohail sweeps this one towards square leg for a single.
Fuller one again, loopy ball, around off. Omaima Sohail presses forward and defends this one out.
Slower through the air, flighted delivery, full and around off. Omaima Sohail blocks it out.
Pulls her length back a tad, around middle and leg. Omaima Sohail flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Goes 'round the wicket now, serves a fuller one, around off. Omaima Sohail pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller one, loopy ball, around middle. Bismah Maroof eases it towards square leg for a single.
Omaima Sohail walks out to the middle. Jess Jonassen has been handed the ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in the first two overs for Australia Women and Pakistan Women's batting woes continue! Iram Javed looks to big again, but she holes out this time. A length ball, around middle. Iram Javed looks to heave this one over mid-wicket. But the ball goes off the top edge towards mid-wicket. Grace Harris there settles under it and pouches it safely!
Commentary.Howout: c Grace Harris b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! Down the leg side, fullish ball. Iram Javed looks to flick this one but she misses. Wide called!
A length delivery, around middle. Iram Javed miscues her pull shot towards mid on.
Fuller one, outside off. Iram Javed drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! First boundary for Pakistan Women! Good aggression shown by Iram Javed! A fuller one, outside off. Iram Javed leans forward and carves it over cover for a boundary.
On a length, hint of away movement, outside off. Iram Javed blocks it out.
Darcie Brown begins with a fuller ball, angling in, around middle. Bismah Maroof flicks it towards mid-wicket. Single taken!
Darcie Brown will bowl from the other end.
Up and over! Full once again, around off. Iram Javed lifts it over mid off. Only two taken! A successful first over from Megan Schutt!
Pitches it up again, around middle and leg. Iram Javed flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller one, around middle. Iram Javed pushes it back to the bowler.
Iram Javed is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket on the third ball of the innings! Megan Schutt gets rid of Muneeba Ali! She was one of few batters who has scored some runs. But will have to walk back for a duck this time! A fuller now from 'round the wicket, outside off. Muneeba Ali looks to drive this but the ball lobs up off her outside edge. Darcie Brown at backward point takes a good catch. First blood drawn!
Commentary.Howout: c Darcie Brown b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker now, around middle. Muneeba Ali does well to dig this one out.
Megan Schutt begins with a fuller ball from over the wicket, around off. Muneeba Ali shows the full face of her bat and drives it to the fielder at cover.
